blocks.text: ILOILO CITY, Philippines — Personnel of Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) arrested 32 individuals and seized some P2.29 million worth of suspected illegal drugs in a series of coordinated operations across Western Visayas, authorities said on Tuesday. The intensified anti-crime drive, conducted from 6 a.m. on Nov. 9 to 5:59 a.m. on Nov. 10, also coincided with a notable milestone: zero recorded incidents among major “focus crimes” within the 24-hour period. These crimes include murder, homicide, physical injury, rape, robbery, theft, and stealing of motor vehicle or motorcycle.
